subject: Marketplace entry coverage mapping & bundle packaging for AWS/Azure/GCP
body:
From: Catherine Luo <catherine@cloudparks.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudParks Partnerships <partner@cloudparks.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 12:03:22 -04:00
Subject: Marketplace packaging & regional coverage — initial ask

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. CloudParks is lining up partners for our marketplace storefront and we want to understand Redwood's recommended SKU/packaging approach across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Key asks from our side:

- A concise set of entry SKUs per cloud (we prefer 1–3 SKU variants to start).
- Region recommendations (which clouds first in US/EU/APAC for co-sell enablement).
- Any co-sell tagging or marketplace asset requirements (Docs, video, joint case studies).

Attached is a short intake (CloudPark-MAP-v1.pdf) with our listing checklist. Can you share a proposed mapping and a one-pager for internal review? Ideally before your partner kick-off next week.

Best,
Catherine
Partnerships, CloudParks

---

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
To: Catherine Luo <catherine@cloudparks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging & regional coverage — initial ask

Catherine — thanks for the clear brief and the checklist. Looping in Ben and Marissa from Marketplace and GTM so we can return a concise mapping.

Quick summary of what we'll deliver:
- Proposed product SKUs (one recommended starter SKU + 1 optional performance SKU per cloud)
- Region sequencing (US West, US East, then EU West; APAC on request or via partner pilot)
- Co-sell readiness checklist and recommended asset set (docs, deployment reference, case study stub)

I attached an initial SKU matrix (20260802-marketplace-sku-matrix.xlsx) — draft — that Ben and Marissa will refine. Can you confirm whether CloudParks requires separate ARM/Intel images for Azure/GCP listings?

If agreeable, we'll schedule a 30-minute sync on Wed 8/4 to walk the mapping and next steps (DocuSign + asset handoff).

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Head of Channel GTM — Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0143

Attachments: 20260802-marketplace-sku-matrix.xlsx

---

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Catherine Luo <catherine@cloudparks.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2026 10:02:31 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging & regional coverage — initial ask

Adding a pragmatic proposal from product/ops perspective — keeping it tight to minimize listing friction: 

Proposal (short):
- SKU A (Starter): "Redwood Inference - Starter" — 8k context, quantized, single-region (US) — CPU+GPU entry variant (bring-your-own-managed or hosted API).
- SKU B (Performance): "Redwood Inference - Scale" — 32k+ context, multi-GPU perf variant, regional failover.

Per-cloud nuances:
- AWS: Full parity for both SKUs; recommend listing in us-west-2 + us-east-1 first. AWS co-sell metadata: support for AMI-based quickstart and CloudFormation template.
- Azure: Prefer single SKU (Starter) initially with VM image + marketplace-managed offer. Avoid multi-GPU initially — Azure image certification takes longer. Prioritize westus2 + northeurope.
- GCP: Recommend Starter + Performance but use a single VM image covering Intel/AMD; GCP region priority us-central1 then europe-west1. For APAC, do a pilot in asia-southeast1 on request.

Co-sell eligibility notes:
- Tag each listing with "co-sell-ready" only after we validate SLA/uptime for the dedicated offering.
- Provide a partner playbook (1-pager) and a joint customer proof template — Marissa, can you draft?

Operational asks:
- Karthik: please confirm image and SKU naming constraints for Azure and GCP so we publish matching artifacts.
- Marissa: prepare the partner playbook + doc checklist.

Ben
Director, Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Catherine Luo <catherine@cloudparks.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2026 09:36:12 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging & regional coverage — initial ask

Love the tight framing. A few additions on packaging and go-to-market: 

- Limit public listings to two SKUs per cloud initially (Starter + Performance). Keep pricing bands standardized across clouds for easier co-sell tracking.
- For Azure, we should mark the Performance SKU as "preview"—require opt-in via partner registration to reduce support load.
- Assets: one deployment quickstart (CloudFormation/ARM/Deployment Manager), 1-page playbook, 2 short videos (1 product, 1 partner co-sell pitch).
- Legal/procurement: will need a standard marketplace MSA + a short co-sell addendum. Catherine — does CloudParks have a standard marketplace MSA we should mirror?

Next steps:
1) Karthik to confirm artifact/naming constraints by EOD Tue.
2) I’ll assemble the one-pager + playbook draft and upload to the shared sheet.
3) Avery to confirm the Wed 8/4 09:30 PT sync — I'll include a short checklist and the DocuSign draft link.

DocuSign: DocuSign:0A9F-CP-MAP-v1 (draft)

Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Manager, Marketplace — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0192

Attachments referenced: CloudPark-MAP-v1.pdf

From: Catherine Luo <catherine@cloudparks.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2026 16:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace packaging & regional coverage — initial ask

Marissa / team — this looks great and very pragmatic. CloudParks has a template MSA we can share; I’ll send it right after this note.

Wed 8/4 09:30 PT works for our PM and me. We also prefer the preview gating for Azure Performance SKU. Please send the playbook draft and DocuSign link in the calendar invite so our legal can review ahead of time.

One small ask: can we add a short checkbox for "co-sell enablement" on the partner registration flow? That will help surface eligible listings to our co-sell ops team.

Talk soon — thanks again!
Catherine
Partnerships, CloudParks
